# A glossary holding no terms

`Glossary: gls-none-terms-section-empty` `DRAFT`

A glossary whose Terms section is the heading and nothing else.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `part-none` is exercised where the section is present and holds no
headings, which `required-section` and `empty-section` both pass over.
